lines.4: 「(Whoa! She's even prettier up close! Is she the best prospect in the entire first year?)」
lines.6: Fukahire pushed up the rim of his glasses.
lines.10: 「How... How developed are first-years these days?!」
lines.11: 「Whoa, calm down, Shinichi. Keep a clear head.」
lines.12: 「I'm Shinichi Samesuga from Class 2-C. Call me Shark.」
lines.13: 「My hobby is stargazing. I'm pretty into nature. My favorite insect is the Caucasus beetle. I feel a certain kinship with those magnificent horns.」
lines.15: 「So, are you interested in the student council?」
lines.19: 「The student council is recruiting fresh talent to lead our school into tomorrow.」
lines.20: 「Wouldn't you like to work under our charismatic president, Erika Kiriya?」
lines.23: 「But look, I checked the student roster, and you aren't in a club, right?」
lines.24: 「Why not make something meaningful of your youth by joining the student council?」
lines.25: 「The work is easy. You don't have to overthink it.」
